gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-gf-syncopate: Kohinoor Zerone draws round letters like bent wire, precise and contemporary. Syncopate, plain sans with spacing like rungs on a rope ladder, would swallow the heading's bent-wire precision if that heading shrank.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-manrope: Contemporary at the top, Kohinoor Zerone draws its round letters like bent wire. And Manrope follows with a bright gap in every curve and one unbroken line width, which feels friendly against all that wire.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-satoshi: Precise from the first curve, Kohinoor Zerone bends round letters like wire. Kohinoor Zerone is made for display, but Satoshi is the one with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e that never squeezes shut.
gen-fs-kola-fs-epilogue: Epilogue's curvy, tall-bodied letters feel unclamped, with stubby ascender tips. Across paragraphs its wire-like monoline skeleton keeps the text moving smoothly, while Kola holds the top, bold and plain.
gen-fs-kola-fs-public-sans: A hefty lowercase with broad open counters reads sturdy under the bold Kola heading. Public Sans carries the trustworthy, professional text, while Kola does the bold, distinctive display work.
gen-fs-kola-fs-supreme: Crisp, thick-looking text runs through the middle of Supreme, its letters held open rather than curled shut. Kola announces, bold and distinctive, and Supreme quietly takes over the reading.
gen-fs-kola-general-sans: General Sans reads with steady pen pressure and an x-height that fills the line. And across many lines each bend keeps a smooth, unobstructed path, a quiet partner to Kola.
gen-fs-kola-gf-orbit: The text hums softly, curves stopping short and characters floating apart, far from the bold Kola heading. Orbit's rope-like consistency in every stem, bowl and tail is what makes the pairing hold.
gen-fs-kola-gf-science-gothic: Cut-sheet crispness: Kola goes bold up front while Science Gothic keeps one cutting width and stroke ends set far apart. Kola declares, then Science Gothic spells it out letter by letter.
gen-fs-kola-manrope: Manrope leaves a bright open gap at every curve and steps only slightly from capitals to lowercase. And down a page of it, the pen line holds one width, a friendly counterpoint to bold Kola.
